title: HOA Reserve Project Bid Comparator
oneLiner: A board finance dashboard that compares contractor bids against reserve-study priorities, cash timing, and owner disruption risk before a community project is approved.
targetUser: HOA board treasurers, community association managers, and reserve planning consultants.
keyUX: Compare bids side by side, inspect reserve impact and timing, and see which project package is safest to approve this quarter.
stitchPrompt: Design a desktop board-finance dashboard called HOA Reserve Project Bid Comparator for HOA treasurers and community association managers. It should help decision makers compare contractor bids against reserve-study priorities, project urgency, cash timing, and resident disruption before approving large community repairs. Include a reserve health summary, a bid comparison matrix, a project cashflow timeline, a component urgency panel, an owner disruption heatmap, and a board recommendation summary. Design direction: use a financial-analyst aesthetic with deep navy, cool gray, muted green, and restrained amber accents so the screen feels fiduciary, calm, and precise rather than salesy.
